caption:
An India-born CEO just built an AI tool for 10,000 Indian school labs. To help every teacher run hands-on science experiments.

At India's AI Impact Summit in February 2026, Google - led by India-born CEO Sundar Pichai - partnered with NITI Aayog's Atal Innovation Mission to bring generative AI into classrooms. The result, ATL Saathi, is a Gemini-powered desktop app giving teachers a 24/7 planning assistant for India's Atal Tinkering Labs. It launched in 100 schools first, scaling toward the 10,000-plus labs already running nationwide.

India built 10,000 school labs for hands-on science. An Indian-born tech CEO just made sure every teacher running one has an AI assistant too.

Sources: Deccan Herald, Digit (2026)
